{"test_name":"Ledger_2297_Objection1","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection1\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task CompositeResolver_NetStandard13Defined_OmitsExcludeFromCodeCoverageAndCompiles()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\nusing MessagePack.Formatters;\n\nnamespace TempProject\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class MyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    public sealed class CustomResolver : IFormatterResolver\n    {\n        public static readonly CustomResolver Instance = new CustomResolver();\n\n        public IMessagePackFormatter<T> GetFormatter<T>() => null;\n    }\n\n    [CompositeResolver(typeof(CustomResolver))]\n    public partial class MyCompositeResolver\n    {\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        var parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(\n            LanguageVersion.Latest,\n            preprocessorSymbols: new[] { \"NETSTANDARD1_3\" });\n\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80\n            .ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> references = frameworkRefs\n            .Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, parseOptions) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(\n            new[] { new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator() },\n            parseOptions: parseOptions);\n\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(\n            compilation,\n            out Compilation outputCompilation,\n            out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n\n        GeneratedSourceResult generatedResolver = runResult.Results\n            .SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources)\n            .Single(s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"partial class MyCompositeResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        SyntaxTree parsedGeneratedTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(generatedResolver.SourceText, parseOptions);\n        List<string> activeAttributes = parsedGeneratedTree.GetRoot()\n            .DescendantNodes()\n            .OfType<AttributeSyntax>()\n            .Select(a => a.Name.ToString())\n            .ToList();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(activeAttributes, name => name.Contains(\"ExcludeFromCodeCoverage\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        List<Diagnostic> compilationErrors = outputCompilation\n            .GetDiagnostics()\n            .Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error)\n            .ToList();\n        Assert.Empty(compilationErrors);\n    }\n}\n"}
